questions.question: Whom does Ezekiel 13 denounce?
options: The false prophets who prophesy from their own hearts
The foreign nations who scornfully mocked all of Israel
The corrupt priests who had defiled the holy temple
The proud princes who oppressed and crushed the poor
questions.answer: The false prophets who prophesy from their own hearts

questions.question: What image describes the false prophets' work?
options: Building a great house upon the shifting sand
Whitewashing a flimsy wall that will fall
Sewing patches onto a worn-out garment
Pouring new wine into old wineskins
questions.answer: Whitewashing a flimsy wall that will fall

questions.question: Ezekiel 13 says the false prophets cried 'Peace' when there was no peace.
Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own _____ and have seen nothing!
They have misled my people, saying, 'Peace,' when there is no _____.
